description: Search current official OFAC, UK and EU listing names and aliases by word prefix, ignoring case, accents and punctuation. Use this when you have a name; sanctions_get_entry takes a known list/id and sanctions_list_changes monitors changes. Returns matches with names, aliases, programmes, countries and first_seen/last_changed, has_more and lists with official file URLs/check times. At most limit matches are returned without pagination; narrow name/list when has_more. No match is not sanctions clearance; verify the authoritative official list. UN listings are excluded. Free keyless allowance: 100 successful answers/day when metered, unlimited otherwise. API keys retain their credit policy. No MCP payment flow; exhaustion returns the HTTP alternative.

list.description: One list only Allowed: ofac-sdn, ofac-consolidated, uk, eu; e.g. ofac-sdn.

name.description: Name word prefix, e.g. Rosneft; at least 3 normalized letters/digits; case/accent/punctuation-insensitive; no handler-specific maximum length

name: sanctions_search_entries
title: Search current sanctions entries
